results.alertTitle: AWS console sign-in by jane.smith from an external address

summary.tpReason: The alert accurately identifies a successful external AWS IAM login and subsequent API use by jane.smith, but telemetry does not establish that it was unauthorized. MFA was satisfied, the source was consistent, and all observed jane.smith actions were read-only reconnaissance.
summary.fpReason: The login succeeded with MFA from one consistent address (198.51.100.22), using a normal Mac browser and then AWS CLI. No failed logins, write operations, data-object reads, or other corroborating malicious activity were found for jane.smith; the clearly malicious activity belonged to a different account and IP.
summary.whatHappened: At 2026-08-19 17:14:20Z, jane.smith (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/jane.smith) successfully logged into the AWS console from 198.51.100.22 using a Mac Safari/Chromium-style browser. CloudTrail records MFAUsed=Yes and SessionMfaAuthenticated=true. The same MFA-authenticated session used AWS CLI from that address for DescribeInstances at 16:51:50Z, ListBuckets at 16:52:23Z, DescribeTrails at 17:06:05Z, ListUsers at 17:07:20Z, and DescribeAlarms at 17:20:05Z. No jane.smith write or GetObject activity was observed. A separate account, mirage, from 198.51.100.42 performed the confirmed malicious AWS changes and data access; this is not evidence against jane.smith.
keyEvidence: AWSCloudTrail: 2026-08-19 17:14:20Z ConsoleLogin for jane.smith from 198.51.100.22 returned ConsoleLogin=Success, with MFAUsed=Yes and SessionMfaAuthenticated=true.
AWSCloudTrail shows jane.smith activity only from 198.51.100.22, with consistent MFA and read-only actions: DescribeInstances, ListBuckets, DescribeTrails, ListUsers, and DescribeAlarms.
No ErrorCode or failed authentication was present for jane.smith in the investigated period.

CloudTrail separately shows mirage from 198.51.100.42 creating backdoor-svc, attaching AdministratorAccess, launching five instances, accessing sensitive S3 objects, and stopping/deleting CloudTrail; this activity is distinct from the alert subject.
SecurityAlert telemetry confirms the alert is the single-login rule SOC-RULE-0022-AwsConsoleLogin for jane.smith at 17:14:20Z.
researchDone: Retrieved schemas for AWSCloudTrail, SecurityAlert, sign_in_adelete_CL, and OktaV2_CL.
Queried the exact jane.smith login and surrounding AWS CloudTrail events from 16:00Z through 18:30Z.
Queried all jane.smith activity for 2026-08-19 and all activity sourced from 198.51.100.22; both showed only this user and read-only operations.
Checked the exact alert window for failed/error results, write operations, and object access; none were found for jane.smith.
Reviewed nearby AWS activity and related Sentinel alerts; the malicious chain was associated with mirage/198.51.100.42, not jane.smith/198.51.100.22.
No public-web lookup was needed; the available telemetry was sufficient and the address is part of a documentation-style range.
